Summer Camps
services.desc: We can’t wait to welcome campers for an unforgettable summer! Get ready for hands‑on police‑themed activities, new friendships, and the chance to meet some special Calgary Police Service guests. CPS special guest visits are subject to their availability and cannot be guaranteed. Camp hours are from 8:30 AM to 4:15 PM each day. Drop-off time will be between 8:30- 9:00 AM and pick-up time will be between 3:45 PM - 4:15 PM. We will again be offering three camp tiers tailored to different age groups - ensuring smaller, age-appropriate experiences that are fun, engaging and, of course, unforgettable!
